description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing provisioning transactions within the Fineract integration tests. It includes various CRUD operations for provisioning categories, criteria, and entries via REST API endpoints, primarily used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: ProvisioningTransactionHelper
classes.description: Helper class for provisioning transaction management in Fineract integration tests, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete provisioning categories, criteria, and entries.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all provisioning categories from the server.

methods.name: createProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning criteria using provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a specific provisioning criteria by its ID.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Updates a provisioning criteria identified by its ID with new JSON data.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Deletes a provisioning criteria by its ID.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Creates new provisioning entries with provided JSON data.

methods.name: updateProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing provisioning entry identified by entry ID.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning entry by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning entries filtered by entry ID.
